# OpenClaw Gateway Log Analysis

## 1. Top 3 Root Causes by Frequency

### #1 — Telegram Polling Stalls (`getUpdates` timeouts)
- **Count:** ~210 paired entries (`Polling stall detected` + `polling runner stopped`) ≈ **~45–50% of all errors**
- **Evidence:**
  - `2026-03-09T02:12:00.448-07:00 [telegram] Polling stall detected (no getUpdates for 894.31s); forcing restart.`
  - `2026-03-10T04:32:55.443-07:00 [telegram] Polling stall detected (no getUpdates for 1081.91s); forcing restart.`
  - `2026-03-11T02:54:43.947-07:00 [telegram] Polling stall detected (no getUpdates for 1017.86s); forcing restart.`
- **Root cause:** Long-poll `getUpdates` HTTPS connections hang (no data, no FIN) for ~15–18 minutes. Coincides with `[telegram] fetch fallback: forcing autoSelectFamily=false + dnsResultOrder=ipv4first` (2026-03-07T20:28:38.588Z) and a later `enabling sticky IPv4-only dispatcher (codes=UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT)` (2026-03-16T20:28:17.113-07:00). Indicates an upstream Node/undici socket leak or NAT/firewall idle-timeout dropping established TCP without RST. The gateway only notices when the >~900s watchdog fires.

### #2 — Telegram API 404 cascade on `deleteWebhook` / `deleteMyCommands` / `setMyCommands`
- **Count:** ~150 lines (5-line bursts repeated ~30 times) ≈ **~30%**
- **Evidence:**
  - `2026-03-07T11:37:07.707Z [telegram] deleteWebhook failed: Call to 'deleteWebhook' failed! (404: Not Found)`
  - `2026-03-07T11:37:07.710Z [telegram] [default] channel exited: Call to 'deleteWebhook' failed! (404: Not Found)`
  - `2026-03-07T11:37:08.195Z [telegram] command sync failed: GrammyError: Call to 'setMyCommands' failed! (404: Not Found)`
- **Root cause:** A `404 Not Found` from Bot API on every method means the bot **token is invalid/revoked** (Telegram returns 404 for bad tokens, not 401). Each channel start tries `deleteWebhook` → fails → channel exits → restarts → loops. Earlier (11:31–11:36 Z) the same calls failed with `Network request ... failed!` — likely no DNS/connectivity — then once network recovered the underlying token problem surfaced as 404.

### #3 — Embedded agent run failures (provider errors / rate limits / timeouts)
- **Count:** ~60+ lines ≈ **~12–15%**
- **Evidence:**
  - `2026-03-13T20:05:41.683-07:00 [compaction] Full summarization failed, trying partial: Summarization failed: You have hit your ChatGPT usage limit (plus plan). Try again in ~6597 min.`
  - `2026-03-15T22:53:27.062-07:00` (then many) `[agent/embedded] embedded run agent end: ... provider=azure-gpt-5.4 error=Unknown error (no error details in response)`
  - `2026-03-17T11:35:24.947-07:00 [agent/embedded] ... error=400 ... Github_copilotException - bad request: unknown Copilot-Integration-Id`
  - `2026-03-11T02:54:43.964-07:00 [agent/embedded] embedded run timeout: ... timeoutMs=600000`
- **Root cause:** Multiple upstream LLM provider faults: ChatGPT Plus quota exhaustion, opaque Azure 5xx ("Unknown error (no error details in response)"), GitHub Copilot integration-id rejection for `claude-opus-4.6-1m` (model misrouted to Responses API), and 600s embedded-run timeouts that also leak `session-write-lock` past `max=720000ms`.

---

## 2. Severity Ranking (operational impact)

| Rank | Root cause | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **1 (highest)** | **#2 — 404 token cascade** | Total outage of Telegram I/O. Causes `delivery-recovery` to exhaust retries and **drop user messages to `failed/`** (`2026-03-09T02:34:30.333-07:00 [delivery-recovery] Delivery 1a18c53c... exceeded max retries (5/5) — moving to failed/`). User-visible data loss. |
| **2** | **#3 — Agent/provider failures** | Directly breaks user-facing replies (`final reply failed`, e.g. `2026-03-13T20:14:24.299-07:00`) and **breaks compaction**, risking session-context corruption. Affects the product's core function (LLM responses). |
| **3** | **#1 — Polling stalls** | Most frequent and noisy, but the watchdog auto-recovers in ~30s. Periodic up-to-18-minute deafness means missed messages, but service self-heals. Lower per-event impact than 1 or 2. |

Bonus lower-severity issues worth noting: invalid `openclaw.json` (JSON5 parse failures at `2026-03-08T11:50:33.168Z` and `2026-03-09T02:32:30.752-07:00`); session lock held past max (`2026-03-11T02:54:43.883-07:00 ... 1017388ms (max=720000ms)`); mDNS name conflicts (~15× `[bonjour] gateway name conflict resolved`) suggesting duplicate gateway processes.

---

## 3. Remediation

**#2 (404 cascade)** — Highest priority
- Verify each bot token via `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getMe`; rotate via @BotFather and update `channels.telegram.accounts.<name>.token`.
- Add a startup health-check: on `404 Not Found` for `getMe`/`deleteWebhook`, mark the channel **disabled** (do not enter restart loop) and emit a single critical alert.
- Cap `delivery-recovery` retries with exponential backoff and **do not** drop to `failed/` while the failure mode is `4xx auth` — quarantine instead so messages can be replayed after token fix.

**#3 (Agent/provider errors)**
- For `provider=azure-gpt-5.4` "Unknown error (no error details in response)": log full HTTP status + body; add provider-side retry with jitter; circuit-break after N consecutive failures and failover to a healthy profile (the failover machinery at `2026-03-16T00:47:18.557` already exists — extend it beyond `rate_limit`).
- For Copilot 400 (`unknown Copilot-Integration-Id`, `model claude-opus-4.6-1m does not support Responses API`): set the required `Copilot-Integration-Id` header and route Copilot-Anthropic models to the **Chat Completions** endpoint, not Responses.
- For ChatGPT Plus quota: detect the quota-exhausted message and stop the retry loop (the log shows ~5 back-to-back compaction retries within 3 minutes, all guaranteed to fail for ~6597 min).
- Increase `embedded run timeoutMs` above 600000 for compaction/large sessions, and ensure `session-write-lock` `max` is ≥ run timeout (currently 720000 vs runs that take 1017388ms).

**#1 (Polling stalls)**
- Lower the stall watchdog from ~900s to **90–120s** (Telegram long-poll `timeout=50` should never be silent for 15 min).
- Set explicit socket-level keepalive on the undici dispatcher (`keepAliveTimeout`, `bodyTimeout`, `headersTimeout` ~ 70s) so dead NAT sessions surface as `UND_ERR_*` instead of hanging.
- Keep the IPv4-only sticky dispatcher (already auto-enabled 2026-03-16) but make it persistent in config rather than fallback-triggered.
